articles.summary: John Ciampaglia, CEO of Sprott Asset Management, breaks down why tightening uranium supply, surging global demand from countries like India and China, and renewed nuclear policy support could set the stage for a major move in uranium prices. Ciampaglia joins Jimmy Connor of Bloor Street Capital for a lively discussion on the positive prospects for uranium markets and nuclear power.
articles.title: Why Uranium Could Be the Next Energy Shock Opportunity
